The fuzz wall blossoms then collapses into isolated bass and rim clicks. Exposed singing electric guitar solo with bent strings, a fast turn, space between phrases and harmonic feedback. Full band octave reprise then a ringing A add9 chord. All instruments, no vocals, no singing, no choir, no spoken words.
